structured.answer: I didn't choose anything today. If I did, it would probably be an S&P 500 tracker at a big name like Altshuler Shaham or Meitav, at about 0.54–0.58% fee, but 143 near-identical rows and a top group with no visible company name stopped me.

stuck.why: Rows start with no company name above them, so I didn't know whose cheapest 0.54% tracks these were
The company header row scrolled away and I lost which company the rows belonged to
Every row looks the same, the fees are all about 0.6%, I got bored and nearly closed the page
Didn't know whether it means bad or just new, so I couldn't compare the S&P tracks

Company header rows scroll away, so I lost which company the rows belong to
Fees shown only as small percentages, nothing in shekels
